property_summary: Owner calls Command with msg.value=1 ether to an EOA, then calls multiplicate with msg.value=0 to transfer all balance: reference forwards 1 ether to target, so multiplicate sends remaining balance (0) and contract balance becomes 0; buggy sends 0 to target, so multiplicate sends remaining balance (1 ether) and contract balance becomes 0. Finally, checking target's balance shows difference: reference gives 1 ether, buggy gives 0.
change_summary: Replace `adr.call{value: msg.value}(data)` with `adr.call{value: 0}(data)` to ignore the sent value.
